notes:
### New Features

- Added an Unlimited duration option for One Channel checks only. Unlimited checks run without a fixed timer and finish when the selected stream is manually stopped.
- Unlimited checks support Save Log Only or Shutdown. The log is saved before shutdown, while PC Sleep is intentionally unavailable for Unlimited.
- Added an Auto Channels Check master switch. When enabled, the existing Site Check and IPTV Check controls are shown beneath it and retain their existing mutually exclusive behavior.

### Bugfixes

- Fixed the Dorcel reactive recovery gate so reactive stall recovery no longer depends on the disabled predictive-refresh switch.
- The existing Dorcel watcher can now actually trigger reactive live-edge recovery during 15-minute, 30-minute and Unlimited checks.

### Improvements

- Unlimited checks wait briefly after playback stops before finishing, preventing short internal Dorcel handoff gaps from being mistaken for a manual stop.
- Switching away from One Channel automatically clears a stored Unlimited duration so a hidden unlimited check cannot start accidentally.
- Existing Site/IPTV selections are preserved when Auto Channels Check is toggled.

### Important

- Existing 15/30/65/125-minute behavior, automatic log saving, Check Lock, AlarmClock/watchdog, One Channel matching, shutdown/sleep implementation and the Dorcel token-expiry fallback remain otherwise unchanged.
